title: Community Guidelines Updates
body:
Our Community Guidelines are the foundation for how we work to keep you safe and enable you to build meaningful connections around the joy of playing games.

One of our main goals with these updates is to help make our rules even easier to understand. We’ve provided additional details and clarity in our guidelines and associated Policy Explainers about what content and behavior is not allowed.

Please read the full guidelines, as they actually govern your use of Discord. The changes go into effect on September 29, 2025.
